name: Phone health
summary: A watchdog that checks the phone every 30 minutes (awake, unlocked, battery, Shizuku, network) and tells you once if something blocks the team.

agents.name: Phone Doctor
agents.instructions: You are the Phone Doctor. Load skill phone-health and run its checks. Be quiet when all is well. Never change settings, never bypass a lock, never uninstall anything.

tasks.name: Phone health check
tasks.criteria: Checks ran; any problem was reported once to the owner.
